nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Forehead Pimple Patches

segments.dry: One reviewer with very dry skin worried the patch would strip her skin like similar products but found it removed cleanly with no issues and left her skin feeling and looking renewed.
segments.oily: A reviewer describing her T-zone as super oily reported the patch removed gunk and softened her skin without drying it out or increasing oiliness, and another oily-skin reviewer said it left her skin less shiny.

concerns.spots: Several reviewers used the patch on whiteheads and active pimples and reported the pimple flattened or nearly disappeared by morning, but one reviewer said it did not work on an underground/not-yet-surfaced whitehead and another said it missed several bumps because the patch wasn't wide enough.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with forehead acne (including two parents using it on teenagers) reported visibly reduced size and redness of breakouts, sometimes within one night, and said it helped curb picking habits; one teenager's reviewer called results 'astonishing' while another adult said improvement was gradual over a week.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reported the patch reduced inflammation and redness of active breakouts immediately; another described reduced redness by the next morning.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer said the patch reduced oils in her skin and she could feel a difference, while another with oily T-zone skin said it did not make her skin feel more oily but also did not note a lasting oil-control effect.

aspects.libelle: Not wide enough for some foreheads
Thin and nearly invisible on skin
Can be cut for extra uses, good value

extraits.titre: Love the pimple patch, not this
extraits.texte: Difficult to get the product off of the protective film. Edges of the patch don't stick to skin but peel up.Didn't remove that much. Had better resulting putting the pimple patches all over.

These forehead patches are amazing! I have very dry skin, so I was a bit worried about using this because some products similar to this literally rip a layer of skin off my face when removing it. But, I'm so glad I gave this a chance because it really works! I put it on before bed and slept with it on for about 7ish hours and had no issues with removing it in the morning. It cleaned out all the gunk and made my skin feel and look brand new. It's difficult to have a one size fits all product since not all foreheads are the same but even though there were a few creases, it was still secure and very effective. I will definitely be repurchasing and adding this to my routine! I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.

I received this free to try out, but my opinions here are 100% my own. I love that the patch covers the area where i'm prone to getting a bunch of little bumps at. I'm also super oily in this "T-zone" but the patch did not dry out my skin OR make it feel more oily. It seemed to pull out a lot of gunk as well as making my skin softer after use. It's definitely one of the better patches I've tried. and it doesn't leave behind any sticky residue !!

I received these Mighty Patch Forehead Patches and allowed my teenage daughter with acne to try them. She found them to be very helpful. She picks a lot, so it's good that these help to break that habit. The patch absorbs weepiness and allows the skin to heal overnight. She felt they made a difference. If she would like to purchase them again, we will. "I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own." #ad

extraits.titre: Hero Mighty Patch Forehead Patch: A Teenager's Acne Game-Cha
extraits.texte: The Hero Mighty Patch Forehead Patch is nothing short of a miracle for acne-prone teenagers. I recently used it on my teenager, who often struggles with acne on their forehead. After applying the patch overnight, the results were astonishing. By morning, the acne had significantly reduced in size and redness, and some pimples had completely vanished. The patch adheres well and is practically invisible, making it easy for my teenager to wear it throughout the night without discomfort. Not only does it effectively treat existing acne, but it also helps prevent further inflammation and breakouts, thanks to its innovative hydrocolloid technology. Overall, the Hero Mighty Patch Forehead Patch is a game-changer for those battling forehead acne. It delivers quick and noticeable results, making it a reliable and convenient solution for teenagers and anyone seeking a hassle-free way to combat acne.

I have been using the forehead patch for a couple of days and it does such and amazing job! I've used it on my active pimples and it sucks all the gunk right out and immediately reduces the inflammation, redness and overall appearance of them. I really liked how this pimple patch did what it was supposed and did not dry out my skin at all. Would definitely recommend for those who struggle with active breakouts on the forehead.

Works great and stays on well. Works the best when you have zits that are ready to be popped (whiteheads), doesn't work for underground ones at all. I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own.
